```{r}
library(parallel)
library(nimble)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(coda)

odo <- read.csv('input/Sönke/odoTraits.csv')
dfo <- merge(dfo, odo)
```

# modello bayesiano per TempIndex

```{r}
source('R-script/multiBayes.r')
glimpse(dfo)

## temp index
test_species <- dfo %>%
  group_by(Temp_Group) %>%
  distinct(species) %>%
  #slice_head(n = 1) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(gindex = Temp_Group) %>%
  select(species, gindex)

# IW (indication weight)
test_species <- dfo %>%
  group_by(IW_Group) %>%
  distinct(species) %>%
  #slice_head(n = 1) %>% # per estrarre solo una specie per gruppo
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(gindex = IW_Group) %>%
  select(species, gindex)

all_results <- odoMultiSpecies_AllGroups(test_species, ncores = 7)
```
